Per-creature identity clause + humanoid silhouette anchor, keyed by BESTIARY DESIGN ID. buildCreaturePrompt() (generate/charsheet.mjs) appends style-laws.json's styleClause LAST, after the clause — the same F-024 law job-costume.json follows; putting the style words in the opening `positive` array does not reproduce the validated prompt string. Both entries are validated:false — authored from the bestiary row's visualBrief, NOT yet visually confirmed on a contact sheet. QC each on its own row before trusting it, exactly as job-costume.json's seven unvalidated jobs. HARD LIMIT: only humanoid-raider body plans can be generated at all. The `character` profile is img2img anchored on silhouettes cut from the approved human row, and style-laws law #1 says text alone cannot hold head-body ratio — so quadrupeds, insects, plants and hulks (92 of the 116 designs) have no anchor and are out of reach until a non-humanoid silhouette set exists.
